name: Broadcast Hour
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Near-Earth Hub: Broadcast Center, System Update 2021's NBN identity, which draws a card the first time each turn it creates a remote server. On Pay to Win's frame, its identity swapped. Two Turtlebacks for its two Drago Ivanov, a Jinteki asset that gains a credit whenever a server is created; two Hostile Infrastructure for its two Chekist Scion, a Jinteki asset that does a net damage whenever the Runner trashes a Corp card, itself included. Ten influence of seventeen. Pay to Win keeps every card given up here. Tranche 8 Stage 4. Tranche 8 Stage 7b: two Tollbooth for its two Virtual Service Agent, a code gate for a code gate, whose 3[credit] the Runner must pay if able or the run ends; Paid Content, Grand Opening and Pay to Win keep Virtual Service Agent.
